question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of sentences with an underlined word followed by four words or group of words. Select the option that is opposite in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

The number of tests conducted dropped further on Saturday with a total of 67,624 tests of which 20% were the less __precise__ rapid antigen tests.
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Rough.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: Word Meaning Precise exact and accurate. (एकदम सही) Rough not exact or detailed. (सटीक या विस्तृत नहीं) • ​​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: Word Meaning Complicated difficult to understand or deal with. (उलझा हुआ) Inevitable certain to happen; unavoidable. (अनिवार्य) Adequate satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity. (पर्याप्त) • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Precise' and 'Rough' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 3. 34:T175b,
